title: Peggy’s cove and Lunenburg heritage tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Peggy’s Cove & Lunenburg Tour

Discover two of Nova Scotia’s most iconic coastal destinations. Visit Peggy’s Cove, famous for its rugged granite coastline, picturesque fishing village, and historic lighthouse. Continue to Lunenburg, a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its colourful waterfront, historic architecture, and rich maritime heritage.

Enjoy stunning coastal views, memorable photo opportunities, and fascinating stories of Nova Scotia’s fishing and seafaring traditions throughout the journey.
